mentions.name: Music publisher data management suite
mentions.description: This suite provides data management for music publishers, mapping all the data formats publishers work with, organizing them better, and building a suite of apps around that data.
mentions.problem: Music publishers work with many different data formats that need better organization.
mentions.source_excerpt:
data management for music publishers. This came out of nowhere but has got me back into coding, deploying, test. And I've got real lessons using AI-generated code that I wouldn't have got just reading other ppl's blog posts! 
We've been mapping all the data formats publishers work with, how to organise them better and build a suite of apps around it.
